newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU management committee to pare fishmeal refunds.
newsitem.headline: EU management committee to pare fishmeal refunds.

text.p: Retrospective refunds of import duty paid on imports of Norwegian fishmeal feed are to be scaled back by the European Union's cereals management committee on Thursday, an EU official said.
"The European Commission has received applications relating to shipments which amount to double the annual quota," the official said.
The Commission invited applications for retrospective repayment of duty because the regulation introducing the EU duty-free quota was published late in the official journal.
The committee will now scale back all repayments, the official added.
